review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: In this role, Quality Assurance and software testing will be the primary focus , while Business Analysis skills will be essential to ensure that business requirements are correctly understood, translated into testable specifications, and validated throughout the software delivery lifecycle. The ideal candidate combines strong hands-on QA and testing experience with solid Business Analysis skills . You will work closely with Business Stakeholders, Product Managers, Developers, Designers, and QA teams to ensure that requirements are clear, solutions are functionally correct, and delivered products meet both business expectations and quality standards. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys analysing requirements, designing and executing tests, identifying defects, supporting UAT, and ensuring end-to-end product quality .
